description: This file defines a collection of static functions under the enum 'SessionActions' to perform session management tasks such as patching, resetting, deleting, and compacting sessions, as well as displaying alerts and opening session logs. It interacts with a 'ControlChannel' for requests and uses AppKit for UI alerts.

classes.name: SessionActions
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to manage sessions, display alerts, and open session logs in a macOS environment.

methods.name: patchSession
methods.description: Asynchronously patches a session with optional thinking and verbose levels by sending a request through ControlChannel.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session identified by a key via a request to ControlChannel.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session and its transcript based on the provided key.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Compacts a session, limiting the number of lines in the transcript.

methods.name: confirmDestructiveAction
methods.description: Displays a warning alert to confirm a destructive action, returning true if confirmed.

methods.name: presentError
methods.description: Displays an error alert with a specified title and error details.

methods.name: openSessionLogInCode
methods.description: Attempts to open a session log in code editor; if unavailable, opens in Finder.
